title: 52 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Inner Peace)
description:
Learn 52 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 52 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Inner Peace · 内心平静
1:20  Love · 爱
2:37  Hobbies & Free Time · 爱好与休闲
3:52  Weather & Small Talk · 天气与闲聊
5:12  Public Transportation · 公共交通
6:33  Patience · 耐心
7:53  Feelings & Emotions · 感受与情绪
9:14  Courage · 勇气

PHRASE LIST

INNER PEACE · 内心平静
• My mind settles, bit by bit - 我的心慢慢沉静下来  [Wo de xin MAN man chen jing xia lai]
• I choose calm over rush - 我把冷静选在匆忙前面  [Wo ba leng jing xuan zai cong mang qian mian]
• Quiet inner answers come first - 先听见内心的答案  [Xian ting jian nei xin de da an]
• Let your shoulders drop right now - 现在就放松肩膀  [Xian zai jiu fang song jian bang]
• I slow down inside, too - 我在心里也放慢节奏  [Wo zai xin li ye fang man jie zou]
• Calm is my default response - 冷静是我默认的回应方式  [Leng jing shi wo mo ren de hui ying fang shi]

LOVE · 爱
• Love you, even when life gets loud - 我爱你，哪怕生活很吵闹  [Wǒ Ài Nǐ, nǎpà shēnghuó hěn chǎonao]
• I want your laugh in my day - 我想要你的笑声陪着我一天  [Wǒ xiǎng yào nǐ de xiàoshēng péizhe wǒ yìtiān]
• Your kindness makes me softer - 你的善意让我变得更柔软  [Nǐ de shànyì ràng wǒ biàn de gèng róuruǎn]
• Let me love you, slowly - 让我慢慢爱你吧  [Ràng wǒ mànman ài nǐ ba]
• I choose peace, because of you - 因为有你，我选择安稳的日子  [Yīnwèi yǒu nǐ, wǒ xuǎnzé ānwěn de rìzi]
• I miss you, even in silence - 你不在的时候，我也会想你  [Nǐ bú zài de shíhou, wǒ yě huì xiǎng nǐ]

HOBBIES & FREE TIME · 爱好与休闲
• I go cycling on weekends. - 周末我骑自行车出去走走。  [ZHOUMO wǒ QÍ zìxíngchē chūqù zǒuzou.]
• I play badminton after work. - 下班后我打羽毛球。  [XIABĀN hòu wǒ dǎ yǔmáoqiú.]
• I love weekend hiking trails. - 我喜欢周末去徒步路线。  [WǑ xǐhuan ZHOUMO qù TÚBÙ lùxiàn.]
• I do yoga to reset. - 我做瑜伽放松一下。  [Wǒ zuò YÚJIĀ fàngsōng yíxià.]
• Evenings are for reading novels. - 晚上的时间我用来看小说。  [Wǎnshàng de shíjiān wǒ yòng láikàn xiǎoshuō.]
• I brew tea and slow down. - 我泡杯茶，慢慢来。  [Wǒ pào bēi chá, mànman lái.]

WEATHER & SMALL TALK · 天气与闲聊
• Is it raining there now? - 你那边现在在下雨吗？  [Ni na bian XIANZAI zai xià yǔ ma?]
• Looks cloudy, stay warm. - 看起来要多云了，记得穿暖点。  [Kan qi lai yao duoyun le, JIDE chuan nuan dian.]
• The wind feels chilly today. - 今天风有点儿冷。  [Jintian fēng you dian er lěng.]
• Did the storm pass already? - 那场暴风雨过去了吗？  [Na chang BAO FENG YU guo qu le ma?]
• It’s so hot for this season. - 这个季节这么热，真不舒服。  [Zhe ge ji jie zheme re, zhen bu shu fu.]
• Is it humid in the evening? - 晚上会不会很潮湿？  [Wan shang hui bu hui hen chao shi?]
• I forgot an umbrella. - 我忘了带伞。  [Wo wang le dai san.]

PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION · 公共交通
• I need the metro to downtown. - 我要坐地铁去市中心。  [Wǒ yào zuò dìtiě qù shì zhōngxīn.]
• How much is a one-way ticket? - 一张单程票多少钱？  [Yì zhāng dānchéng piào duōshǎo qián?]
• Where is the nearest bus stop? - 最近的公交站在哪儿？  [Zuìjìn de gōngjiāo zhàn zài nǎr?]
• Does this line stop at the airport? - 这条线路到机场吗？  [Zhè tiáo xiànlù dào jīchǎng ma?]
• Can I pay with a contactless card? - 我可以刷手机或银行卡吗？  [Wǒ kěyǐ shuā shǒujī huò yínhángkǎ ma?]
• Is there a transfer to Line Two? - 可以换乘二号线吗？  [Kěyǐ huànchéng èr hào xiàn ma?]
• What time does the last train leave? - 末班地铁几点发车？  [Mòbān dìtiě jǐ diǎn fāchē?]

PATIENCE · 耐心
• Breathe, you can handle this. - 呼一口气，慢慢来，你能行。  [HU YI KO QI, MAN MAN LAI, NI NENG XING.]
• I ll respond after I think. - 我会先想想，再慢慢回你。  [WO HUI XIAN XIANG XIANG, ZAI MAN MAN HUI NI.]
• Listen first, act later. - 先听清楚，再决定怎么做。  [XIAN TING QING CHU, ZAI JUE DING ZEN ME ZUO.]
• Give it time to land. - 先让它慢慢沉下去，别急。  [XIAN RANG TA MAN MAN CHEN XIA QU, BIE JI.]
• When stuck, pause and reset. - 卡住了就停一下，换个角度继续。  [KA ZHU LE JIU TING YI XIA, HUAN GE JIAO DU JI XU.]
• Slow hands, steady results. - 手慢一点，结果更稳。  [SHOU MAN YI DIAN, JIE GUO GENG WEN.]

FEELINGS & EMOTIONS · 感受与情绪
• I feel restless today. - 我今天有点坐立不安。  [Wǒ jīntiān yǒudiǎn zuò lì bù ān.]
• I’m feeling a little anxious. - 我有点紧张，心里七上八下。  [Wǒ yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng, xīnli qī shàng bā xià.]
• I’m oddly calm right now. - 我现在挺平静的。  [Wǒ xiànzài tǐng píngjìng de.]
• That makes me feel warm. - 听到这话，我心里暖暖的。  [Tīngdào zhè huà, wǒ xīnli nuǎn nuǎn de.]
• I’m really happy for you. - 我真替你高兴。  [Wǒ zhēn tì nǐ gāoxìng.]
• I feel relieved, finally. - 我终于松了一口气。  [Wǒ zhōngyú sōng le yì kǒu qì.]
• I don’t like this pressure. - 我不喜欢这种压力。  [Wǒ bù xǐhuan zhè zhǒng yālì.]

COURAGE · 勇气
• Call it courage, then do it - 把它叫勇气，然后就去做  [Bǎ tā jiào yǒngqì, ránhòu jiù qù zuò]
• Ask anyway, even if it’s awkward - 就算尴尬也要开口问  [Jiù suàn gān gà yě yào kāikǒu wèn]
• Walk in, don’t wait for permission - 走进去，不用等允许  [Zǒu jìnqù, bú yòng děng yǔnxǔ]
